questions.question:
Rearrange the following jumbled sentences to make a meaningful one

P : weather conditions across a vast geographic

Q : the climate of India

R : scale and varied topography

S : comprises a wide range of

The proper sequence should be :
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **QSPR**.**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• The sentence 'Q**' is independent of any other sentences as it is giving general information about the climate of India. Hence, '**Q**' is the first part.
 
• Comprises refers back to the** climate of India** mentioned in the sentence '**Q**'. Hence, '**S**' follows '**Q**'.
 
• It will be followed by** P **as wide range has been used for the weather conditions in India.
 
• **'Geographic' **is an adjective which will be followed by a noun i.e. **scale**. Therefore, the sentence '**R**' is the concluding sentence. 

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: The climate of India* *comprises a wide range of weather conditions across a vast geographic scale and varied topography.

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__***

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

questions.question:
If three numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 5 and the twice their sum is 100. Find the square of the largest of the three numbers.

A. 225

B. 625

C. 25

D. 100
questions.solution:
Let, the numbers are 2x, 3x, and 5x

According to the problem,

⇒ 2 × (2x + 3x + 5x) = 100

⇒ 2 × (10x) = 100

⇒ 20x = 100

⇒ x = 5

∴ The largest number is = 5x = 5 × 5 = 25

∴ Square of the largest number = (25)² = 625

questions.question:
A piece of cloth costs Rs. 35. If the piece were 4 m longer and each meter was to cost Rs. 1 lesser, then the total cost would remain unchanged. How long is the piece of cloth?

A. 10 m

B. 14 m

C. 12 m

D. 8 m
questions.solution:
Let, length of the piece of cloth = x m

Cost of cloth = Rs. 35

∴ Cost of 1 m cloth = Rs. 35/x

According to the question,

⇒ (x + 4) (35/x - 1) = 35

⇒ 35 - x + 140/x - 4 = 35

⇒ 35x - x² + 140 - 4x = 35x

⇒ x² + 4x - 140 = 0

⇒ x² + 14x - 10x - 140 = 0

⇒ x(x + 14) - 10(x + 14) = 0

⇒ (x + 14) (x - 10) = 0

⇒ x = - 14 or 10

**∴ The piece of cloth is 10 m long**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

We can tabulate the given data according to the following table:

 
 

 
 Rate of cloth (in Rs./m²)
 Length of cloth (in m²)
 
 

 Initially
 x (assume)
 y (assume)
 
 

 Finally
 x – 1
 y + 4
 
 

 

As the total remains constant at Rs.35, we get:

xy = 35 

⇒ x = 35/y ----(i)

Also, (x – 1) × (y + 4) = 35 ----(ii)

On substituting the value of x from equation (i) into equation (ii), we get:

[(35/y) – 1] × (y + 4) = 35 

On solving, we get:

y = -14 and 10

∴ The piece of cloth is 10 m long

questions.question:
Which of the following is correct?

Sound waves are _________ waves.
questions.solution:
This type of wave is a longitudinal wave. Longitudinal waves are always characterized by particle motion being parallel to wave motion. A sound wave traveling through air is a classic example of a longitudinal wave.

A wave in which the particles vibrate in the same direction of propagation of the wave is called a longitudinal wave.

Longitudinal waves can be produced in all three media such as solids, liquids, and gases. The waves which are produced in the air are always longitudinal.

questions.question: Which of the following coloured light has the lowest Frequency?

__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• 
 
Electromagnetic waves: The wave which is generated due to vibration between electric field and magnetic field and it does not need any medium to travel is called an electromagnetic wave. It can travel through a vacuum.

 
 
• 
 
Light is a form of energy which is an example of an electromagnetic wave.

 
 
• 
 
Wavelength: The distance between two successive crests or troughs is called wavelength of the wave.

 
 
• 
 
**Frequency**: The number of vibration per unit time is called frequency. 

 
 
 

Speed of wave (v) = frequency (f) × wavelength (λ)

 
• 
 
White light consists of seven constituent colours: Violet (V), Indigo (I), Blue (B), Green (G), Yellow (Y), Orange (O), Red (R).

 
 
• The frequency of the color light in the order from highest to lowest is given as acronym VIBGYOR (V > I > B > G > Y > O > R).

EXPLANATION__:

questions.question:
A closed wooden rectangular box made of 1 cm thick wood has the following outer dimensions: length 22 cm, breadth 17 cm, and height 12 cm. It is filled with cement. What is the volume of the cement in the box?

A. 1488 cu. cm

B. 3000 cu. Cm

C. 4488 cu. Cm

D. 2880 cu. cm
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Thickness of wood = 1 cm

Length of box = 22 cm

Breadth of box = 17 cm

Height of box = 12 cm

**Calculation:**

Inner length of the box = (22 − 2) = 20 cm

Inner breadth of the box = (17 − 2) = 15 cm

Inner height of the box = (12 − 2) = 10 cm

Inner volume of the box = (20 × 15 × 10) = 3000 cu. Cm

**∴ Volume of cement in the box is 3000 cu. cm**

questions.question:
Divide 3740 in three parts in such a way that half of the first part, one-third of the second part and one-sixth of the third part are equal.

A. 700, 1000, 2040

B. 340, 1360, 2040

C. 680, 1020, 2040

D. 500, 1200, 2040
questions.solution:
Let, the parts are x, y and z

According to the question,

⇒ x/2 = y/3 = z/6

Let, x/2 = y/3 = x/6 = k

∴ x = 2k, y = 3k and z = 6k

According to the question,

⇒ 2k + 3k + 6k = 3740

⇒ 11k = 3740

⇒ k = 3740/11 = 340

∴ First part = 2k = 2 × 340 = 680

∴ Second part = 3k = 3 × 340 = 1020

∴ Third part = 6k = 6 × 340 = 2040

questions.question:
The area of ΔABC is 63 sq. units. Two parallel lines DE, FG, are drawn such that they divide the line segments AB and AC into three equal parts. What is the area of the quadrilateral DEGF?

A. 28 sq. units

B. 35 sq. units

C. 21 sq. units

D. 48 sq. units
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cce84fe0d7eb9b697e132c031ac5b73f82eb7380bff7b3abdd60a536ac5a485.png] 

Let, AD = DF = FB = x units and AE = EG = GC = y units

According to the question,

⇒ Area of ΔADE/Area of ΔABC = (AD/AB)²

⇒ Area of ΔADE/63 = (x/3x)²

⇒ Area of ΔADE = 63 × 1/9

⇒ Area of ΔADE = 7

According to the question,

⇒ Area of ΔAFG/Area of ΔABC = (AF/AB)²

⇒ Area of ΔAFG/63 = (2x/3x)²

⇒ Area of ΔAFG = 63 × 4/9

⇒ Area of ΔAFG = 28

∴ Area of the quadrilateral DEGF = Area of (ΔAFG - ΔADE) = (28 - 7) = 21 sq. units

questions.question:
The sum of digits of a two-digit number is 9. When the digits are reversed, the number decreases by 45. Find the number.

A. 45

B. 72

C. 63

D. 27
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of digits of two-digit number = 9

When digit are reversed then the number decreased by 45

**Calculation:**

Let the two-digit number be 10x + y

So, the reversed number is 10y + x

Now, According to the question

x + y = 9 ----(1) 

10x + y = 45 + 10y + x

⇒ 9x - 9y = 45

⇒ x - y = 5 ----(2) 

From (1) and (2), we get 

x = 7 and y = 2

**∴ The two digit number is 10 × 7 + 2 = 72**

questions.question:
Six years ago, the ratio of the ages of the two persons P and Q was 3 : 2. Four years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 8 : 7. What is P’s age?

A. 10 years

B. 12 years

C. 14 years

D. 8 years
questions.solution:
Let, 6 years ago, age of P = 3x and age of Q = 2x

According to the question,

⇒ (3x + 10)/ (2x + 10) = 8/7

⇒ 21x + 70 = 16x + 80

⇒ 5x = 10

⇒ x = 2

∴ P’s age = 3x + 6 = (3 × 2) + 6 = 12 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Concept used:**

Basics of ratio and proportion.

**Calculation:**

Six years ago P ∶ Q = 3 ∶ 2

 ↓ 5 unit = (6 + 4 = 10 years)

Four years hence P ∶ Q = 8 ∶ 7

1 unit → 10/5 = 2 years

Age of P after 4 years = 8 × 2 = 16

Present age of P = 16 - 4 = 12 years
